chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
If any of you intends a need, then let him seek it early and hasten his walking toward it.

key_terms.الْحَاجَةَ: a need, matter, or objective to be fulfilled
key_terms.فَلْيُبَكِّرْ: let him go early or begin early

ai.seo_question: What does Imam عليه السلام teach about the best way to pursue one's needs?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches promptness and diligence in pursuing one’s needs. The saying encourages beginning important matters early and approaching them with energy and resolve.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If any of you intends to fulfill a need, let him seek it early in the morning and hasten in walking towards it."
